accessibility.snapshot.result: Accessibility tree and optional artifact path

app.crash.result: {crashed: true}; arguments: {mode: abort}; the adapter must use a target-native forced crash path

app.upgrade.result: {applied: true}; arguments: {fromVersion, toVersion}; install the supplied candidate through the platform-native upgrade path

app.version.result: {schemaVersion: 1, version: string}; observe the installed Overte product version

asset.load.result: {requested: true}; completion is verified independently by fixture telemetry and probe.snapshot

audio.mute.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {muted: boolean}; use the target's real microphone-mute control path

collaboration.edit.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {entityName, value}; mutate the controlled entity through an independent fixture actor

collaboration.snapshot.result: {schemaVersion: 1, entityName, value, revision, actorId}; independently observe controlled shared entity state

create.cube.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {name: controlled unique name, properties: {color, dimensions}}; select My avatar and Cube, create through the normal Shape button and apply actual property fields

create.delete.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {names: up to 3 unique names from one owned run}; delete only matching owned objects through ordinary UI, idempotent when absent

create.import.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {url: owned /create/<session>/entities.json or missing.json}; normal avatar-host Import URL controls only

create.redo.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; activate the ordinary Create Redo control

create.reference.close.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {scriptUrl: owned observer.js}; stop only the diagnostic through Running Scripts and dismiss owned panels/dialogs

create.reference.open.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {scriptUrl: owned observer.js}; load the read-only diagnostic via ordinary script consent and open normal Create

create.undo.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; activate the ordinary Create Undo control

create.update.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {name: controlled unique name, properties: {color, dimensions}}; select the actual owned entity and apply ordinary editor fields

entity-script.review.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; drive the displayed production consent dialog for the controlled entity script, retaining world/source binding

input.look.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {horizontal: number from -1.0 through 1.0, vertical: number from -1.0 through 1.0}; positive means right/up

input.move.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {direction: backward|forward|left|right, durationSeconds: number from 0.1 through 10.0}

input.primary.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; perform one primary pointer press and release on the controlled world interaction target

permission.set.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {permissionId: microphone, state: denied|granted}; drive the native OS permission path

places.back.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; activate normal Back history, reopening the panel if necessary

places.close.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; close only the owned Go To/Places panel and partial dialogs

places.forward.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; activate normal Forward history, reopening the panel if necessary

places.goto.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {url: controlled scene.json with one of the three owned viewpoint queries}; use the real address editor and Go control

places.open.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; open the normal Go To or Places entry

probe.snapshot.result: Overte probe snapshot schema version 2; arguments: {afterSampleSequence?: positive integer}; result sequence must be greater when supplied

render.snapshot.result: Render presentation snapshot v1: backend, hardware acceleration, visible surface, black-frame classification, and monotonic frame sequence

scene.load.result: {requested: true, verification?: fixture-markers}; arguments: {url: absolute URL}

scene.reload.result: {requested: true, commandId: string, verification?: fixture-markers}; arguments: {url: absolute URL}; explicitly resets an already controlled scene

scripts.load-url.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {url: owned /script-management/<session>/client.js or missing.js}; use the real From URL dialog and normal script consent, never a probe load command

scripts.manager.close.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; close only the owned Running Scripts panel and dialogs, including partial failures

scripts.manager.open.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; open the ordinary Running Scripts panel

scripts.restart.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {url: owned fixture client.js}; activate the matching owned row Restart control, never call a script service API

scripts.stop.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {url: owned fixture client.js}; stop only the matching owned row through normal UI; idempotent if absent, never Stop All

setting.set.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {settingId: audio.warn-when-muted, enabled: boolean}; use the semantic product setting control

snapshot.capture.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {mode: still|animated|panorama|cubemap, format: png|jpg, name: bounded owned prefix}; select normal SNAP controls and deliver the capture action only

snapshot.close.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; cancel/close only the owned capture through normal controls and restore the initial format selection

snapshot.files.result: {files: [{basename, artifact}]}; arguments: {prefix: bounded owned prefix}; copy only observed original app SNAP files to private immutable run artifacts; never generate or re-encode

snapshot.open.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; open the ordinary SNAP app and preserve its initial format selection for cleanup

sound.play.result: {requested: true, commandId: string}; playback must be verified independently through probe.snapshot and fixture request telemetry

tablet.activate.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {contractVersion: 1, controlId: semantic ID from tablet-ui-contract.json}

tablet.snapshot.result: Semantic tablet UI snapshot contract version 1, schema version 1

telemetry.memory.result: Legacy capability retained for adapter compatibility

telemetry.snapshot.result: Portable battery, memory and thermal sample

text.dismiss.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; remove focus from the controlled E2E text field and dismiss any platform keyboard

text.focus.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {}; focus and clear the repository-owned controlled E2E text field

text.snapshot.result: Text input snapshot contract version 1: {schemaVersion, value, focused, keyboardVisible, submittedCount}

text.type.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {text: bounded Unicode string, backspaceCount: integer 0..32, submit: boolean}; use the target's real text-input path

voice.exchange.result: Voice test contract v1: execute a bounded native test-build command and return the exact fresh result; captured PCM is private and transient.

web.reference.close.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {surface: world|tablet}; close the owned reference through normal client controls and stop only its diagnostic script

web.reference.open.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {surface: world|tablet, scriptUrl: HTTP(S) /parity/client.js}; load the owned diagnostic through Running Scripts and expose the selected normal Web surface

web.reference.pause.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {surface: world|tablet}; activate the real Pause control; stable encoded pixels are verified independently

web.reference.play.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {surface: world|tablet}; activate the real Play control; playback is proved separately from native screenshot bytes

web.reference.seek.result: {performed: true}; arguments: {surface: world|tablet, seconds: 0|4}; use the owned reference's red/blue seek button; the actual target video frame is verified independently
